title: nflrest
text: nfl_schedules_sample contains 2024 2025 schedules kickoff times, final scores, closing spreads, rest, venue columns, examples run without network connection. functions accept data frame required columns, bundled sample. calculate_rest_disparity() needs game_id, gameday, home_team, away_team; calculate_travel_miles() needs game_id, home_team, away_team, uses stadium_id, location, week, gameday present. flag_time_zone_shifts() uses gametime present assumes 1:00 p.m. Eastern otherwise. schedule nflreadr::load_schedules() columns can passed directly. Live ingestion available optional nflreadr dependency: first call needs network access; later calls reuse -memory cache. Install nflreadr separately suggested dependency.
code: library(nflrest)  # Rest disparity, short weeks, and byes rest <- calculate_rest_disparity(nfl_schedules_sample)  # One row per team-game with travel miles. The default itinerary model # chains consecutive road games; use trip_model = "round_trip" for the # older out-and-back version. travel <- calculate_travel_miles(nfl_schedules_sample)  # Team-season travel totals summarize_travel_miles(travel)  # Signed clock shifts and east/west body-clock penalties shifts <- flag_time_zone_shifts(nfl_schedules_sample)  # Composite score; positive values favor the home team advantage <- calculate_schedule_advantage(nfl_schedules_sample)  # Season totals and ranks season <- calc_schedule_disparity(nfl_schedules_sample)  # Compare outcomes for disadvantaged teams; min_edge drops tiny edges eval_rest_impact(nfl_schedules_sample, advantage = advantage, min_edge = 0.5)  # Team-by-venue travel heatmap plot_travel_matrix(travel) schedule <- load_nfl_schedule(2024:2025) clear_nflrest_cache()

title: nflrest
text: calculate_schedule_advantage() converts component points sums : rest: 0.25 points per day rest disparity travel: 0.5 points per 1,000 miles extra travel time zone: 0.35 points per hour body-clock penalty Travel disparity away team’s miles minus home team’s; time-zone disparity away team’s penalty minus home team’s. weights arguments, raw parts returned score. defaults starting point, fitted values; eval_rest_impact() check outcomes. missing part, rest season opener, counts zero shows components_missing.

title: nflrest
text: Rest calendar days team’s games within season. Season openers NA package invent prior game; nflverse reports 7 days openers. Home games zero travel miles. Neutral-site games charge teams trip. Travel great-circle distance team’s home airport venue, actual flight routing. default itinerary model chains road games adjacent weeks resets bye; "round_trip" model treats every road game independent --back trip overstates multi-game road stretches. Time-zone shifts use scheduled kickoff instant IANA time zones, daylight-saving changes handled. Eastward shifts receive larger default body-clock penalty westward shifts. Injury evaluation depends injury report supplied user; injury data bundled. Historical team abbreviations (example OAK, SD, STL) yet mapped airport rows.

what: Calculate rest disparity between home and away teams — calculate_rest_disparity
title: Calculate rest disparity between home and away teams — calculate_rest_disparity
text: Computes team's days rest entering every game gameday, derives rest disparity, short-week flags, -bye flags. Rest computed within season, first game team's season NA rest (nflverse reports 7 season openers).

title: Calculate rest disparity between home and away teams — calculate_rest_disparity
code: calculate_rest_disparity(schedule, short_week_days = 6, bye_rest_days = 13)

title: Calculate rest disparity between home and away teams — calculate_rest_disparity
text: schedule data frame game_id, gameday, home_team, away_team. season used grouping present. short_week_days Rest many days flagged short week. Defaults 6, catches 4-5 day Thursday turnarounds. bye_rest_days Rest many days flagged coming bye. Defaults 13, shortest realistic post-bye rest.

title: Calculate rest disparity between home and away teams — calculate_rest_disparity
text: schedule gameday coerced Date, plus home_rest_days, away_rest_days, rest_disparity, home_short_week, away_short_week, home_off_bye, away_off_bye. Positive rest_disparity means home team better rested.

what: Calculate a composite schedule advantage — calculate_schedule_advantage
title: Calculate a composite schedule advantage — calculate_schedule_advantage
text: Combines rest disparity, travel disparity, body-clock disparity single pre-game score. Positive schedule_advantage favors home team. raw parts point values kept output weighting can checked changed.

title: Calculate a composite schedule advantage — calculate_schedule_advantage
code: calculate_schedule_advantage(   schedule,   team_home = nfl_airports,   venues = nfl_stadiums,   trip_model = c("itinerary", "round_trip"),   points_per_rest_day = 0.25,   points_per_1000_travel_miles = 0.5,   points_per_tz_hour = 0.35,   east_weight = 1,   west_weight = 0.5 )

title: Calculate a composite schedule advantage — calculate_schedule_advantage
text: schedule data frame accepted calculate_rest_disparity(), calculate_travel_miles(), flag_time_zone_shifts(). needs game_id, gameday, home_team, away_team; gametime, stadium_id, location improve accuracy present. team_home Team home-base lookup. Defaults nfl_airports. venues Venue lookup. Defaults nfl_stadiums. trip_model Travel model passed calculate_travel_miles(). Defaults "itinerary". points_per_rest_day Points per day rest disparity. Defaults 0.25. points_per_1000_travel_miles Points per 1,000 miles extra travel. Defaults 0.5. points_per_tz_hour Points per hour body-clock penalty disparity. Defaults 0.35. east_weight, west_weight Multipliers eastward westward clock shifts passed flag_time_zone_shifts(). Defaults 1 0.5.

title: Calculate a composite schedule advantage — calculate_schedule_advantage
text: schedule rest columns calculate_rest_disparity(), plus home_trip_miles, away_trip_miles, travel_disparity, home_tz_shift_hours, away_tz_shift_hours, home_body_clock_penalty, away_body_clock_penalty, tz_penalty_disparity, rest_points, travel_points, time_zone_points, schedule_advantage, components_missing, advantage_category.

title: Calculate a composite schedule advantage — calculate_schedule_advantage
text: default score 0.25 * rest_disparity + 0.5 * travel_disparity / 1000 + 0.35 * tz_penalty_disparity, travel_disparity = away_trip_miles - home_trip_miles tz_penalty_disparity = away_body_clock_penalty - home_body_clock_penalty. missing component (example, rest season opener) contributes zero increments components_missing; raw component columns keep NA omission visible. default weights starting point, fitted values. Use eval_rest_impact() compare components wins spread covers.

what: Calculate per-team travel miles for each game — calculate_travel_miles
title: Calculate per-team travel miles for each game — calculate_travel_miles
text: Builds one row per team per game estimates travel team's home airport venue. Home games zero miles; neutral-site games require teams travel. Venue coordinates come nfl_stadiums via stadium_id, falling back home team's airport venue unknown game normal home game.

title: Calculate per-team travel miles for each game — calculate_travel_miles
code: calculate_travel_miles(   schedule,   team_home = nfl_airports,   venues = nfl_stadiums,   trip_model = c("itinerary", "round_trip") )

title: Calculate per-team travel miles for each game — calculate_travel_miles
text: schedule data frame game_id, home_team, away_team. stadium_id identifies venue; location ("Home"/"Neutral") determines whether designated home team travels. season, week, gameday carried present. gameday required default "itinerary" model. team_home Team home-base lookup: data frame team, airport, latitude, longitude. Defaults nfl_airports. venues Venue lookup: data frame stadium_id, stadium, latitude, longitude. Defaults nfl_stadiums. trip_model count road trip. "itinerary" (default) chains consecutive road neutral-site games: team stays road charged leg previous venue, return leg charged last game returns home. "round_trip" treats every road neutral game independent --back trip, overstates mileage multi-game road stretches.

title: Calculate per-team travel miles for each game — calculate_travel_miles
text: tibble one row per team per game: game_id, season, week, gameday, team, opponent, is_home, location, venue_stadium_id, venue, venue_source, home_airport, trip_miles, round_trip, travel_model.

title: Calculate per-team travel miles for each game — calculate_travel_miles
text: trip_miles mileage attributed team-game. itinerary model, final game road trip includes flight home, summing trip_miles season gives full itinerary. Consecutive road games adjacent weeks chained; bye longer gap resets team home airport, clubs normally return home bye. Distances great-circle (haversine) miles, actual flight routing. round_trip legacy flag: TRUE means team left home base, including neutral-site game designated home team. mean "round_trip" model used; see travel_model.

title: Evaluate whether schedule disadvantages show up in outcomes — eval_rest_impact

title: Evaluate whether schedule disadvantages show up in outcomes — eval_rest_impact
code: eval_rest_impact(   schedule,   outcomes = NULL,   injuries = NULL,   advantage = NULL,   metrics = c("rest", "travel", "time_zone", "composite"),   injury_statuses = c("Out", "Doubtful"),   min_edge = 0,   ... )

title: Evaluate whether schedule disadvantages show up in outcomes — eval_rest_impact
text: schedule schedule accepted calculate_schedule_advantage(). outcomes Optional data frame game_id, home_score, away_score (optionally spread_line). Use schedule already carry results. Columns outcomes override matching columns schedule. injuries Optional injury report season, week, team, report_status status column, output nflreadr::load_injuries(). NULL, injury columns NA. advantage Optional precomputed output calculate_schedule_advantage(). NULL, computed schedule (...). metrics components evaluate: "rest", "travel", "time_zone", "composite". Defaults four. injury_statuses Injury statuses counted unavailable. Defaults c("", "Doubtful"). min_edge Minimum absolute edge required count game disadvantaged. Defaults 0, includes non-zero edge. units follow selected metric (rest days, miles, body-clock hours, composite points); use something like 0.5 composite. ... Arguments passed calculate_schedule_advantage() advantage NULL.

title: Evaluate whether schedule disadvantages show up in outcomes — eval_rest_impact
text: tibble one row per metric. games number games non-missing component; disadvantaged_games counts games min_edge. Win rates exclude ties denominators, cover rates exclude pushes. Injury summaries cover games injury data teams.

title: Evaluate whether schedule disadvantages show up in outcomes — eval_rest_impact
text: positive component favors home team, away team disadvantaged side; negative component makes home team disadvantaged. Games abs(edge) < min_edge left disadvantaged/advantaged comparison. win_rate_diff, cover_rate_diff, injury_diff always disadvantaged minus advantaged, negative value means disadvantaged side worse.

what: Flag body-clock shifts for each team and game — flag_time_zone_shifts
title: Flag body-clock shifts for each team and game — flag_time_zone_shifts
text: Computes signed time-zone shift team experiences relative home time zone, using scheduled kickoff instant. instant converted team's home zone venue zone, daylight-saving changes handled operating system's time-zone database.

title: Flag body-clock shifts for each team and game — flag_time_zone_shifts
code: flag_time_zone_shifts(   schedule,   team_home = nfl_airports,   venues = nfl_stadiums,   default_kickoff = "13:00",   east_weight = 1,   west_weight = 0.5 )

title: Flag body-clock shifts for each team and game — flag_time_zone_shifts
text: schedule data frame game_id, gameday, home_team, away_team. gametime used present; otherwise default_kickoff assumed. stadium_id, location, season, week carried present. team_home Team home-base lookup team time_zone. Defaults nfl_airports. venues Venue lookup stadium_id time_zone. Defaults nfl_stadiums. default_kickoff Kickoff time U.S. Eastern time used gametime absent missing. Defaults "13:00". east_weight Multiplier eastward clock shifts. Defaults 1. west_weight Multiplier westward clock shifts. Defaults 0.5, since eastward shifts usually harder body clock.

title: Flag body-clock shifts for each team and game — flag_time_zone_shifts
text: tibble one row per team per game: game_id, season, week, gameday, team, opponent, is_home, location, venue, team_time_zone, venue_time_zone, kickoff_utc, kickoff_home_local, kickoff_venue_local, tz_shift_hours, tz_direction, eastward, westward, body_clock_penalty. Positive tz_shift_hours means team travels east.

title: Flag body-clock shifts for each team and game — flag_time_zone_shifts
text: normal home game zero shift. Neutral-site games can shift designated home team , playing away home time zone. body-clock penalty east_weight * max(shift, 0) + west_weight * max(-shift, 0).

title: NFL schedule sample (2024-2025) — nfl_schedules_sample
text: stadium_id venue game actually played , including 15 neutral-site games (12 international, two Super Bowls, one wildfire relocation). location flags neutral sites, travel functions know teams flew. Note gameday stored ISO 8601 character string, Date, gametime Eastern time rather venue local time. Together support date-aware body-clock calculations.

what: Plot a team-by-venue travel matrix — plot_travel_matrix
title: Plot a team-by-venue travel matrix — plot_travel_matrix
text: Draws heatmap mean travel miles every team-venue pair travel frame. Useful spotting long trips, neutral-site outliers, teams whose schedules concentrate travel cities.

title: Plot a team-by-venue travel matrix — plot_travel_matrix
code: plot_travel_matrix(travel, fill_label = "Mean trip miles", season = NULL)

title: Plot a team-by-venue travel matrix — plot_travel_matrix
text: travel per-team-game travel frame calculate_travel_miles(), data frame team, venue, trip_miles. round_trip present, home games dropped plot shows travel rather zero-mile home dates. fill_label Legend label. Defaults "Mean trip miles". season Optional season seasons keep plotting. Requires season column travel. NULL, seasons travel averaged together.

title: Plot a team-by-venue travel matrix — plot_travel_matrix
text: ggplot object.

title: Plot a team-by-venue travel matrix — plot_travel_matrix
text: Requires suggested package ggplot2. Cells mean trip_miles team-venue pair; missing combinations blank.

title: Plot a team-by-venue travel matrix — plot_travel_matrix
code: travel <- calculate_travel_miles(nfl_schedules_sample) if (requireNamespace("ggplot2", quietly = TRUE)) {   plot_travel_matrix(travel, season = 2024) }

what: Summarise travel miles for each team — summarize_travel_miles
title: Summarise travel miles for each team — summarize_travel_miles
text: Aggregates per-trip frame produced calculate_travel_miles() season totals, mean road-trip length, longest single trip, furthest opponent visited. default itinerary travel model, totals include return leg charged final game road trip.

title: Summarise travel miles for each team — summarize_travel_miles
code: summarize_travel_miles(travel, by = NULL)

title: Summarise travel miles for each team — summarize_travel_miles
text: travel per-team-game travel frame calculate_travel_miles(), data frame team trip_miles. is_home, round_trip, opponent used present. Character vector grouping columns. Defaults team plus season season available.

title: Summarise travel miles for each team — summarize_travel_miles
text: tibble one row per group: grouping columns, games, travel_games (games played away home, including neutral-site "home" games), total_miles, mean_trip_miles, longest_trip_miles, furthest_opponent, missing_trips (games unknown mileage).
